verdict.rationale: The official docs describe a model selector drop-down under the conversation prompt box for choosing the reasoning model. Hands-on community reports confirm models from multiple providers (Gemini 3 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-OSS 120B) and note it is not locked to Gemini. Missing for 10: first-party documentation listing the supported providers and models, and evidence that model choice is available across CLI and SDK surfaces (the multi-provider evidence comes from an early community report only).
